style: Ink and watercolour illustration for a children's chapter book, lively loose black ink linework, light transparent watercolour washes, warm paper tone, detailed backgrounds, expressive children with natural proportions, in the spirit of classic illustrated adventure novels for young readers. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no speech bubbles.

personnages.jeanne: one small seven-year-old girl, the smallest of the group, with fair freckled skin, big green eyes and a wild mop of curly bright ginger hair, wearing bright red dungarees over a white t-shirt and white sneakers
personnages.gaspard: one stocky eight-year-old boy with warm brown skin, short black curly hair and round black glasses, wearing a turquoise sleeveless jacket with two big pockets over a cream jumper, brown shorts, brown lace-up boots, and a short yellow pencil tucked behind one ear
personnages.suzie: one small round seven-year-old girl with rosy pale skin, soft brown eyes and very fluffy cloud-like curly golden blond hair, wearing a violet pinafore dress over a white blouse and grey tights
personnages.marin: one very tall thin eight-year-old boy, a full head taller than the other children, with tan skin, a long neck, dark eyes and short messy jet black hair with one tuft sticking up, wearing a short bright yellow raincoat with the hood down and navy trousers
personnages.grison: one very tall thin elderly man of about sixty-five, so tall that the children only reach his chest, with light brown skin, kind grey eyes, a long nose, large ears and a bald crown with two big tufts of grey hair sticking up on either side, wearing a bottle green waistcoat with one bulging pocket over a white shirt, and holding a stick of white chalk
personnages.taupin: one short plump man of about sixty, only a little taller than the children, with pale pink skin, round cheeks, small dark eyes always squeezed almost shut and smooth jet black hair slicked flat with a centre parting, wearing a long mustard yellow shop apron over a white shirt, a big brass magnifying glass hanging from a cord round his neck
personnages.bogue: one small stout woman of about seventy, only a little taller than the children, with weathered tan skin, sharp black eyes, stern bushy grey eyebrows and iron-grey hair in a tight round bun bristling with long hairpins, wearing an orange knitted shawl over a dark grey dress and holding a long thin brass lamplighter's pole with a tiny flame at the tip
personnages.colimacon: one tiny, very old, very thin man of about ninety, bent forward, no taller than the children, with pale ivory wrinkled skin, half-closed pale blue eyes, a bald head and a very long white beard reaching down to his belt, wearing a long burgundy velvet coat, dark trousers, polished black shoes and a tiny black bowler hat, leaning on a wooden walking stick
personnages.anselme: one huge broad-shouldered old man of about seventy-five, by far the biggest of all, twice as wide as anyone else, with dark brown skin, small smiling brown eyes, very short white hair and a big bushy white walrus moustache, wearing a wide royal blue work smock and a brown flat cap, a broad brown leather strap across his chest
personnages.raoul: one lean wiry eight-year-old boy of medium height, with olive skin, narrow amber eyes and short chestnut brown hair with one stubborn tuft sticking straight up at the back, wearing a much too big navy blue jumper with the sleeves rolled up grey shorts and scuffed brown shoes, a small bulging cloth marble bag hanging from his belt
personnages.garance: one slim straight-backed eight-year-old girl of medium height, with dark brown skin, big dark eyes with long lashes and black hair in two long neat braids tied with white ribbons, wearing a rose pink dress with a round white collar, and carrying a flat brown leather music case
personnages.titou: one chubby one-year-old baby boy, much smaller than everyone else, with fair skin, round rosy cheeks, big round blue eyes and a nearly bald head with one single ginger curl on top, wearing an apple green knitted romper suit, sitting in a small red wooden pull-cart with four wheels
personnages.mimosa: one tiny four-year-old girl, much smaller than everyone else, only as tall as the other children's chests, with light tan skin, rosy cheeks, big round black eyes and straight black hair in two tiny pigtails sticking straight up, wearing a little sky blue smock and orange rubber boots
personnages.eclusiere: one tall strong woman of about forty, a head taller than the tall boy, with deep brown skin, warm dark eyes and black hair wrapped up high in a bright magenta headscarf, wearing a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up a long dark grey work skirt and black rubber boots, a ring of big iron keys hanging from her belt
personnages.marinier: one very tall lean man of about forty-five, taller than everyone else, with weathered tan skin, dark eyes, a short black beard and black hair tied back in a small ponytail, wearing a thick rust orange fisherman's jumper and a black sailor's cap, a coil of rope over one shoulder
personnages.titoudebout: one chubby one-year-old baby boy, much smaller than everyone else, no taller than the children's knees, with fair skin, round rosy cheeks, big round blue eyes and a nearly bald head with one single ginger curl on top, wearing an apple green knitted romper suit, standing barefoot on wobbly legs with his arms held out for balance

lieux.place: the cobbled main square of a small old French river town, with a tall cream stone belfry tower topped by a golden comet-shaped weathervane, a round stone fountain in the middle, two big plane trees, tall narrow pastel houses with slate-blue roofs, and shop fronts with striped awnings and no writing anywhere
lieux.cour: a small walled school playground of pale sand with one big old cherry tree in the middle, a low stone wall, a little open wooden shelter with one long bench on the left, and a cream schoolhouse with tall windows, green shutters and a small brass bell above the door
lieux.classe: inside a bright old-fashioned classroom with two-seat wooden desks, a big clean empty dark green chalkboard, tall windows, a round black iron stove, a globe on the teacher's desk and a row of brass coat hooks along a pale yellow wall, no writing anywhere
lieux.bazar: inside a small old hardware and sweet shop crammed from floor to ceiling with dark wooden shelves and tiny drawers, big glass jars of coloured sweets and glass marbles on a long wooden counter, a brass till, kites and coils of rope hanging from the ceiling, warm yellow lamp light, no labels and no writing anywhere
lieux.fournil: a small corner bakery with a pale blue wooden shop front, a big window full of round golden loaves, baskets of baguettes and fruit tarts, a plain cream awning with no writing, and warm orange light glowing inside
lieux.maisonhaute: a very tall, very narrow, slightly crooked house painted pale green, with many small windows of different sizes, a steep red tiled roof, washing lines full of small colourful clothes strung from the windows, standing next to an old open stone wash-house with a slate roof at the edge of a slow green river
lieux.quai: a quiet stone quay on a slow green river lined with weeping willows, where one long old barge is moored: a dark green hull, a small red wheelhouse cabin with round windows at the back, pots of red geraniums and a little tin chimney on the flat roof, a thick rope tied to an iron mooring ring on the quay
lieux.ecluse: a small river lock with two big dark wooden lock gates, a white iron footbridge across them and a crank wheel, beside a little white lock-keeper's house with blue shutters, a red tiled roof and a small vegetable garden, calm green water above and below
lieux.moulin: an old stone watermill on a river bank with a big wooden waterwheel turning slowly, a wide open workshop door, neat stacks of pale planks and logs outside, golden sawdust on the ground and a long wooden workbench
lieux.ile: a tiny grassy island in the middle of a slow green river, reached by one narrow wooden plank footbridge, with one huge weeping willow and under it a small hut made of mismatched wooden planks whose roof is an old faded mint green rowing boat turned upside down, a round window and a patchwork curtain for a door
lieux.butte: the top of a round green hill above the town, with one big old linden tree, a wooden bench and one old iron street lamp beside it, and a wide view down over slate-blue roofs, a belfry tower and a looping green river

objets.beffroi: a tall cream stone belfry tower with a pointed slate-blue roof, topped by a golden weathervane shaped like a comet, a star with a long curved tail, and below it a big round white clock face with two black hands and small gold dots instead of numbers
objets.cerisier: one big old cherry tree with a thick twisted dark trunk and a wide round crown
objets.lanterne: an old red metal storm lantern with a glass globe and a small warm yellow flame, hanging from a willow branch
objets.carnet: a small closed turquoise notebook held shut by a black elastic band, with a short chewed yellow pencil
objets.filante: one big clear glass marble with a single white swirl inside, like a tiny comet
objets.boite: a big square dark green tin box with a hinged lid, closed
objets.manege: a small old-fashioned carousel under a red and cream striped canopy edged with little round light bulbs, carrying wooden boats, crescent moons and rockets instead of animals
objets.velo: an old sky blue bicycle with a little rust, a wicker basket on the handlebars and a silver bell
objets.charrette: a small red wooden pull-cart with four wheels
